correctness.rationale: For char(k) !=2, every derivation of T_n is inner and has implementer unique modulo kI. Square-zero ad forces equal diagonal entries and N strictly upper triangular; ad_N²(X)=N²X-2NXN+XN². Testing diagonal E_aa forces N²=0, then matrix-unit sandwich products N_ai N_jb show all nonzero row indices are strictly below all nonzero column indices, equivalent to a common cut c. Each U_c is irreducible and distinct; pair intersections have dimension c(n-d). Inclusion-exclusion on final active row a and first active column b yields exact S_n(q). Characteristic two n4 E12+E34 is a sharp boundary. Independently enumerated formula for q3 and n2..7.
